screen_state.instructions: What is the CURRENT state of this Android screen? Choose loading only when a spinner, skeleton or progress indicator is the main content; permission when a blocking system dialog is in front; error when a failure or retry screen dominates; ready when interactive content is available; unknown when the evidence is insufficient.

criteria.ready: Interactive app content is visible and the user can act.
criteria.loading: The screen is still loading: spinner, skeleton, progress bar, blank placeholder.
criteria.permission: A permission, consent or sign-in dialog is blocking the app.
criteria.error: A failure, offline warning or retry screen dominates.
criteria.unknown: The text does not make the screen state clear.
